items.html: *Further know that these Tikunim of the beard of ZA are mentioned in Parashat Shelach-Lecha, and they are in this manner: Erech one, Apayim two, VeRav Chesed three, Nosse Avon four, VaPesha five, and Vnakke six. Thus they are six. But they are called nine, with the three others, which are: Lo Yenakkeh, Poked, etc., upon the thirds. Behold three others; thus all of them are nine.
